risks.title: Technology competition risk
risks.score_rationale: Ability to introduce competitive technologies and maintain market position against competitors with AI/cloud capabilities is critical to growth

risks.title: Liquidity risk
risks.score_rationale: Need for liquidity to fund operations, restructuring (83M$ in FY2025), share repurchases (1.2B$) and dividends (424M$)

risks.title: Supply chain risk
risks.score_rationale: Disruptions in supply chain could limit ability to ship products and meet customer demand at forecasted prices

risks.title: Credit risk
risks.score_rationale: Issuance of 1.25B$ of Senior Notes (5.50% and 5.70%) in March 2025; management of financing costs

risks.title: Macro market risk
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to global economic conditions, government spending uncertainty, and trade controls including tariffs

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: Obligation to comply with evolving environmental, tax, and contractual regulations for certifications

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk
risks.score_rationale: Ability to anticipate and prevent unauthorized access and sabotage critical for data infrastructure provider; ransomware protection is key differentiator

ai_positioning.summary: NetApp is actively integrating AI into its intelligent data infrastructure strategy. The company positions its data storage and management solutions as foundational for high-performance data pipelines and AI workloads, partnering with leading public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
evidence: Developing scalable, high-performance data pipelines for artificial intelligence (AI) workloads
AI innovation, embedding intelligence into data infrastructure to enable AI workloads
In the AI space, we leverage our expertise in unstructured data management to support the entire AI lifecycle
Support for data foundations and hybrid cloud architectures for responsible AI deployment
